input.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. ONE final-quality 3200x1440 (exact 20:9) full PC pixel-art game screen. A state in the SAME suite, not a poster or wireframe. Input 1 is the corrected battle master, input 2 is the camp master, input 3 is the user's Ricochet Abyss hero pane, input 4 is Darkest Dungeon's attribute panel. Image1 controls shared panel sizes, top status, Chinese font, dark iron edges, quiet brass corners, inventory scale and pixel-art identity. Image2 controls camp architecture only when this screen is in camp. Image3 controls attributes-left and talents-right information organization, not old buttons. Image4 supplies matte dark surfaces and hierarchy, not characters, stats, skills or functions.
Keep top status “幽冥骑士”, “生命 180 / 180”, “体力 100 / 100”, “腐化 0 / 100”, “金币 4”. Full red and cyan bars; EMPTY purple corruption track at zero. Preserve right “随身背包” panel at the same position and size, empty two-base-column inventory with scrollbar. Preserve global tabs at top left in order “装备栏位 / 英雄属性 / 装备图鉴”. These are the ONLY global tabs, no narrow tools strip or bottom icons. Tabs get underline plus subtle light fill when active. Equipment always spans both base cells as one full-width object and only stacks vertically; never put two equipped weapons side by side.
Use a wide dark information pane expanding from below the tabs across the left + central region, stopping before the right carried bag. Keep the top strip and all three tabs visible and accessible, not hidden behind a popup. The pane is a connected continuation of the selected tab, not a separate window without context. Provide a small clear “关闭” at its upper right returning to equipment. Current background room can be dimly visible along edges. All main content fits inside the screen.
Pixel-art only, high-end shadow and light craft, clean bone-white Chinese typography, readable aligned numbers, regular frames, restrained oxidized iron and aged brass. No huge gothic arches on UI, glossy gold, glowing every slot, smooth painted characters, decorative text, jargon, measurement annotations, watermarks, forging, enchanting services, quests, currencies or invented tabs. Only one main action when applicable. This is a rendered design reference, not a claim of runtime implementation.
Select “英雄属性”. Pane title “英雄”. Left approximately 28% of the pane is an orderly attributes table, right 72% is current-character talents and detail. Both are on screen simultaneously; never use a subtab to hide one. The left table reads: “生命 180 / 180”, “体力 100 / 100”, “护甲 0”, “基础伤害 30”, “额外伤害 0%”, “基础生命上限 150”, “额外生命上限 20%”, “弹射距离 500”. Group survival and attack/movement with short headers and thin separators. Do not invent resistances, luck or additional percentages.
Right title “角色天赋”. Six consistent pixel-icon nodes in a spacious 3-by-2 arrangement, named exactly “药剂师”, “博学”, “上肢力量”, “强韧”, “体质”, “敏捷”. Use small recognizable potion / book / arm / shield / heart / feather motifs, not huge illustrative cards. No invented prerequisite lines or branches: this concept has not defined a dependency graph. Beneath nodes, a selected-node detail area with concise effect copy. Node state is expressed by icon lock and words, not color alone.
SCREEN STATE: battle read-only. Darken the actual battle room from Image1 behind the wide pane. All six talent nodes are shown as not yet learned in this explicit design example; do not assert an actual save contains these talents. Select locked “体质” with a thin highlight but keep its lock. Detail: “体质”, “尚未解锁”, “提升10%生命上限。” Bottom small note “战斗中仅可查看 · 返回营地培养天赋”. No upgrade button, no skill-point plus control, no unlock action and no spending price. The whole reason for the page is seeing character numbers on the left and talents on the right at the same time. Keep the three global tabs and right bag. Do not show equipment cards underneath the left stats table. Final screen is coherent and readable, not many separate floating dialogs.

input.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce ONE complete final-quality 3200x1440 image, exactly 20:9, showing a straight-on PC pixel-art dungeon game interface. This is a usable screen in one coherent suite, not a poster, diagram, device mockup, storyboard, or webpage. All visible copy is legible Chinese. The click contracts below define intended affordances; do not print production instructions.

INPUT ROLES, strictly in order:
Image 1, the generated battle master, controls panel footprints, status strip, tabs, fonts, icons, item scale, merged equipment slots, and the shared visual system.
Image 2, the generated camp master, controls the actual architecture, existing characters, and shared preparation components. Preserve its small white-and-gold horned knight and recognizable room.
Image 3, the Darkest Dungeon merchant reference, supplies atmosphere only: sober presence, coarse shadow shapes, object silhouettes, restrained framing. Do not import its characters, features, currencies, prices, or party. Retain any established merchant from Image 2.

LOCKED GEOMETRY: copy Image1's exact panel boundaries, top strip and inventory module. The rendered master uses approximately one-fifth left equipment, three-fifths center, one-fifth right inventory. Shared components stay at identical coordinates. Central service windows never cover side panels or top status; preserve background room cues around them.

Top exact copy: “幽冥骑士”, “生命 180 / 180”, “体力 100 / 100”, “腐化 0 / 100”, “金币 4”. The red and cyan bars are full; the purple corruption track is EMPTY at zero. These are pre-action sample values; do not predict transaction balances. Left top has EXACTLY THREE tabs: “装备栏位”, “英雄属性”, “装备图鉴”. Select “装备栏位” with underline and subtle fill. The shared hero page has attributes left and talents right; the codex contains equipment only. Neither page's contents appear here.

Left equipment interior width360, base square180. EVERY equipped object spans BOTH base cells as ONE continuous full-width card. NO SIDE-BY-SIDE ITEMS; NO CENTER DIVIDER THROUGH OCCUPIED CARDS. Reordering is vertical only. Baseline visible order: locked two-row block, empty row showing two base cells, then green-bottle “凝血毒剂”, green-mushroom “灵魂香菇”, silver-blade/gold-hilt “淬毒利刃”, each occupying one full-width row. Apply only explicitly stated screen-specific relocations. Right title “随身背包”, exactly two base cells across, six visible rows, identical module and item scale, thin scrollbar. Never restore the removed narrow auxiliary strip, little tool slots, book, helmet, back-arrow column, or old bottom information icons.

STYLE: crisp pixel art, charcoal surfaces, thin oxidized iron edges, rare aged-brass corners, bone-white Chinese text, aligned numbers. Type roles 24/28/32/40/48/64 pixels; maximum two container layers. Create premium atmosphere through lighting and contrast, not excessive ornament. No smooth painted characters, realistic replacement knight, glossy 3D panels, neon, repeated skulls, jeweled borders, fake text, or watermarks. Decoration must not resemble extra buttons. No crafting, enchanting, processing, multiplayer, daily quests, roulette, or new currency.

SCREEN: CAMP SAFE STORAGE, one selected item ready to withdraw. The visible title is “保险箱”. Place a calm, substantial storage window within the central region, with a clearly labeled safe grid on its left and selected-item detail on its right. Let the existing camp architecture and actual knight remain visible at the window edges. This is secure storage in the camp, visually distinct from the right-side carried bag. The exact rule text “存入保险箱的物品，死亡后不会丢失” is prominent enough to read without becoming a giant banner. This safety rule is explicitly approved; do not weaken it into a speculative tooltip.

For this deliberate interface example, move the ONE owned green mushroom from its former left equipment row into the safe. Its previous left row becomes empty. The bottle and blade remain equipped in their original rows. The right carried bag is empty. Show the mushroom selected in one full-width safe card, with empty safe rows around it; never depict a duplicate mushroom as still equipped. This relocation demonstrates a prepared storage state, not an extra free item or a verified player save. Use the same 360-pixel two-base-cell merge for this card, centered icon, no dividing line through the item, and restrained selected outline. A modest scrollbar may imply additional storage; do not invent a capacity total or unlockable paid rows.

Selected detail exact title: “灵魂香菇”. Use the current-item text exactly: “每搜寻过一次物品，增加 4 价值。最多不超过 16 。” Show only the familiar green mushroom icon and this concise effect; no price, charge meter, crafting recipe, rarity reward, or new resource.

The primary visible action is “取出到背包”, next to the selected safe item's detail. The secondary “存入保险箱” action is visibly inactive in this particular state because no carried item is selected. Small helpful text may say “选择背包物品后存入”. A clear “返回营地” control exits the service. Keep controls grouped with their objects instead of placing ambiguous arrows between containers.

CLICK CONTRACT: selecting a safe item exposes its detail; withdrawal transfers that owned instance into available carried space and updates both locations. Selecting a carried item enables deposit; deposit moves it into the safe. Insufficient destination space leaves the source object unchanged. Closing returns to camp while preserving completed transfers. These are semantics for the visual design, not extra onscreen instructions. Do not draw an upgrade, repair, interest, fee, insurance purchase, death penalty, auto-sort, or sell control. The safe's death protection requires no invented payment.

FINAL CHECK: clearly separate equipment, carried inventory, and service contents; preserve shared alignment and one strongest action. Show one pre-action state, never duplicated owned instances or conflicting balances. Omit unknown values. Do not print developer notes, evidence IDs, placeholder variables, or measurements. Preserve the fixed frame before atmosphere.

SCREEN: CAMP DUNGEON-FLOOR SELECTION, before entering a floor. The central window is titled “选择地牢”. Preserve the camp from Image 2 behind it, with the actual knight and recognizable entrances. Organize the central window into an uncluttered list of THREE floors and one spacious selected-floor summary. This is a linear floor selector, NOT a branching route map. Do not draw connecting paths, route nodes, forked choices, random encounters, a world map, or multiple destination branches.

Use exactly this intentionally approved illustrative progression: “第1层” with a clear completion mark and “已通关”, plus the quiet label “可重打”; “第2层” is accessible and currently selected, indicated by an underline, fill, and “已选择”; “第3层” is visibly locked and labeled “未解锁”, with an ordinary functional padlock. Do not replace these states with the old runtime floor 4. Do not add floors 4 through 12, invented chapter names, invented biome names, fixed reward amounts, entry prices, star ratings, timers, or a claim that this sample is the user's saved progress.

The selected-floor summary clearly repeats “第2层”. Show a restrained in-world vignette based on the same actual dungeon materials and architecture already established by Image 1, without suggesting an additional new level layout. Keep informational text sparse: the exact phrase “选择地牢层后进入” is enough. The primary action is “进入第2层”. A lower-emphasis “返回营地” control sits nearby. The current selection should read more strongly than the previously completed floor; the locked floor remains legible but visually subordinate.

CLICK CONTRACT: clicking floor 1 selects it for replay and would change the primary action to entering floor 1; clicking floor 2 selects it and shows the current depicted entry action. Clicking the locked floor does not enter it. No specific unlock cost or prerequisite has been established, so do not invent a condition line. Pressing the primary entry action transitions into the selected floor's real game flow. Returning to camp preserves equipment and inventory. Keep the list and detail column visually connected through alignment, not ornate frames around every row. There is one active selected floor, one obvious entry action, and no oversized fantasy parchment scroll. Use sober dark stone and limited warm accents to unify the selection with the camp.
